datasets.usage_boundary: M16 completed explicit development and held-out local-control manifests. M17-001--003 isolated and rejected inadequate Line3D mappings; M17-004--006 established a profile-normal / STEP-projection / extent-boundary selector on five development and two held-out rows. ADR-0017 made that fail-closed selector the default only for the supported Line3D replay subset. M17-008 independently confirmed the default on two further development and one held-out family, without changing syntax or Harness behavior. Existing manifests remain non-default local development inputs only and do not authorize corpus runs, provider input, hosted evaluation or runtime material.
